title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二 Volume 2 Annals 2: Taizu 2

sentences.zh: 洪武元年春正月乙亥，祀天地於南郊，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, spring, the first month, on the day yihai, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the southern suburbs, and he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the first month of spring in the first year of Hongwu, he offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar and took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 定有天下之號曰明，建元洪武。

translations.literal: He fixed the name of possessing All-under-Heaven as Ming and established the era name Hongwu.
translations.idiomatic: He took Ming as the name of his dynasty over all under Heaven and proclaimed the era name Hongwu.

sentences.zh: 追尊高祖考曰玄皇帝，廟號德祖，曾祖考曰恆皇帝，廟號懿祖；

translations.literal: Posthumously he honored his great-grandfather as Emperor Xuan, temple name Dezu, and his great-great-grandfather as Emperor Heng, temple name Yizu;
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored his great-grandfather as Emperor Xuan with the temple name Dezu, and his great-great-grandfather as Emperor Heng with the temple name Yizu;

sentences.zh: 祖考曰裕皇帝，廟號熙祖，皇考曰淳皇帝，廟號仁祖，妣皆皇后。

translations.literal: his grandfather as Emperor Yu, temple name Xizu, his father as Emperor Chun, temple name Renzu; their consorts were all made empresses.
translations.idiomatic: his grandfather as Emperor Yu with the temple name Xizu, and his father as Emperor Chun with the temple name Renzu; all their wives were posthumously titled empresses.

sentences.zh: 立妃馬氏為皇后，世子標為皇太子。

translations.literal: He installed Consort Ma as empress and the heir Zhu Biao as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: He installed Lady Ma as empress and his heir Zhu Biao as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 以李善長、徐達為左、右丞相，諸功臣進爵有差。

translations.literal: Li Shanchang and Xu Da were made left and right chancellors; the various meritorious officials were advanced in rank by differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang and Xu Da were appointed left and right chancellors, and the founding ministers were ennobled in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙子，頒即位詔於天下。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the accession edict was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the accession edict was issued to all the realm.

sentences.zh: 追封皇伯考以下皆為王。

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed the imperial grand-uncle and those below as kings.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously enfeoffed his grand-uncle and the more distant forebears as kings.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李善長、徐達等兼東宮官。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others concurrently held Eastern Palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others were also appointed to offices in the crown prince’s establishment.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣使覈浙西田賦。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, envoys were dispatched to verify the land tax of western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, he sent envoys to audit land-tax registers in western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，胡廷瑞克建寧。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Hu Tingrui captured Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hu Tingrui took Jianning.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征戍將軍，略南陽以北州郡。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Deng Yu was made campaigning frontier general and reduced the prefectures north of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Deng Yu was appointed campaigning frontier general and subdued the prefectures north of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 湯和克延平，執元平章陳友定，福建平。

translations.literal: Tang He captured Yanping, seized the Yuan vice minister Chen Youding, and Fujian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Tang He took Yanping, captured the Yuan vice minister Chen Youding, and pacified Fujian.

sentences.zh: 是月，天下府州縣官來朝。

translations.literal: In this month, officials of prefectures, departments, and counties throughout the realm came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month, magistrates from prefectures, departments, and counties across the empire presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「天下始定，民財力俱困，要在休養安息，惟廉者能約己而利人，勉之。

translations.literal: He instructed them, saying: “The realm has only just been settled; the people’s wealth and strength are both exhausted. What matters is to let them rest and recover. Only the incorrupt can restrain themselves and benefit others—strive for this.
translations.idiomatic: He admonished them: “The empire has only just been pacified, and the people are exhausted in both wealth and strength. What is needed is to let them rest and recover. Only the incorrupt can restrain themselves and benefit others—take this to heart.

sentences.zh: 」二月壬寅，定郊社宗廟禮，歲必親祀，以為常。

translations.literal: ” In the second month, on the day renyin, the rites for the suburban altars, the altars of soil and grain, and the ancestral temple were fixed; each year the emperor must sacrifice in person, and this was made the constant rule.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the second month, on renyin, the rites for the suburban sacrifices, the altars of soil and grain, and the ancestral temple were established; the emperor was to perform them in person every year as a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和提督海運。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Tang He was made superintendent of sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Tang He was put in charge of maritime transport.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠為征南將軍，硃亮祖副之，由海道取廣東。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong was made southern campaigning general, with Zhu Liangzu as his deputy; by the sea route they were to take Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yongzhong was appointed southern campaigning general, with Zhu Liangzu as his deputy, to take Guangdong by sea.

sentences.zh: 丁未，乙太牢祀先師孔子於國學。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, with the yi offering of the great victim he sacrificed to the former teacher Confucius at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he offered the great victim sacrifice to Confucius, the former teacher, at the National University.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀社稷。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, he sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, he sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔衣冠如唐制。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict ordered caps and robes according to Tang regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, an edict prescribed caps and robes after the Tang model.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，常遇春克東昌，山東平。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Chang Yuchun captured Dongchang, and Shandong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Chang Yuchun took Dongchang and pacified Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，楊璟克寶慶。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Yang Jing captured Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yang Jing took Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，詔儒臣修女誡，戒後妃毋預政。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinwei, an edict ordered Confucian officials to compile admonitions for women and warned empresses and consorts not to interfere in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, he ordered Confucian officials to compile admonitions for women and warned that empresses and consorts must not meddle in government.

sentences.zh: 壬申，周德興克全州。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Zhou Dexing captured Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhou Dexing took Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鄧愈克南陽。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Deng Yu captured Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Deng Yu took Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，徐達徇汴梁，左君弼降。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Xu Da reduced Bianliang; Zuo Junbi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Xu Da advanced on Bianliang; Zuo Junbi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，蘄州進竹簟，卻之，命四方毋妄獻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day xinchou, Qizhou presented bamboo mats; he declined them and ordered the four quarters not to present gifts recklessly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, Qizhou presented bamboo sleeping mats; he refused them and ordered the regions not to send unsolicited tribute.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠師至廣州，元守臣何真降，廣東平。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong’s army reached Guangzhou; the Yuan defending official He Zhen surrendered, and Guangdong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yongzhong’s army reached Guangzhou; the Yuan defender He Zhen surrendered, and Guangdong was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祫享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he performed the collective spirit-sharing sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he performed the collective spirit-sharing rite at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐達、常遇春大破元兵於洛水北，遂圍河南。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun greatly defeated Yuan troops north of the Luo River and then besieged Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun routed the Yuan army north of the Luo River and then besieged Henan.

sentences.zh: 梁王阿魯溫降，河南平。

translations.literal: The Liang prince Aruwen surrendered, and Henan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang prince Aruwen surrendered, and Henan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，楊璟克永州。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Yang Jing captured Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yang Jing took Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸汴梁。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the emperor visited Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the emperor went to Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，馮勝克潼關，李思齊、張思道遁。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Feng Sheng captured Tong Pass; Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Feng Sheng took Tong Pass; Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，廖永忠下梧州，潯、貴、容、郁林諸州皆降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jimao, Liao Yongzhong reduced Wuzhou; Xun, Gui, Rong, and Yulin prefectures all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, Liao Yongzhong took Wuzhou; the prefectures of Xun, Gui, Rong, and Yulin all submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改汴梁路為開封府。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Bianliang circuit was changed to Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Bianliang circuit was redesignated Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，徐達朝行在。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengzi, Xu Da attended audience at the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengzi, Xu Da presented himself at the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，海南、海北諸道降。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the circuits of Hainan and Haibei all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the circuits of Hainan and Haibei submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊璟、硃亮祖克靖江。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu captured Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu took Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，廖永忠下象州，廣西平。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuzi, Liao Yongzhong reduced Xiangzhou, and Guangxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi, Liao Yongzhong took Xiangzhou and pacified Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，振恤中原貧民。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, relief was extended to the poor of the central plains.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, he granted relief to the poor of the central plains.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，將還應天，諭達等曰：「中原之民，久為群雄所苦，流離相望，故命將北征，拯民水火。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, about to return to Yingtian, he instructed Xu Da and the others, saying: “The people of the central plains have long suffered under the warlords, wandering in destitution and gazing at one another; therefore I ordered the generals north to rescue the people from flood and fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, as he prepared to return to Yingtian, he told Xu Da and the others: “The people of the central plains have long suffered under rival warlords, displaced and destitute; that is why I ordered a northern campaign to lift them out of misery.

sentences.zh: 元祖宗功德在人，其子孫罔恤民隱，天厭棄之。

translations.literal: The Yuan founding ancestors’ merit and virtue remain among the people, but their descendants paid no heed to the people’s hardships; Heaven has abandoned and cast them off.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan founding emperors’ merit still lives among the people, yet their descendants ignored the people’s suffering; Heaven has turned away from them.

sentences.zh: 君則有罪，民復何辜。

translations.literal: If the ruler is guilty, what crime have the people committed?
translations.idiomatic: If the ruler is at fault, what fault lies with the people?

sentences.zh: 前代革命之際，肆行屠戮，違天虐民，朕實不忍。

translations.literal: In past ages at the time of revolution, slaughter was carried out wantonly, violating Heaven and cruelly harming the people; I truly cannot bear this.
translations.idiomatic: In earlier dynastic changes, armies slaughtered without restraint, defying Heaven and brutalizing the people; I cannot bring myself to do the same.

sentences.zh: 諸將克城，毋肆焚掠妄殺人，元之宗戚，咸俾保全。

translations.literal: When the generals capture cities, they must not recklessly burn, plunder, or kill; the Yuan imperial kin are all to be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: When you take cities, do not burn, plunder, or kill indiscriminately; preserve the Yuan imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 庶幾上答天心，下慰人望，以副朕伐罪安民之意。

translations.literal: Thus above you may answer Heaven’s heart and below comfort human hopes, fulfilling my intent to punish crime and bring peace to the people.
translations.idiomatic: In this way you will answer Heaven above and satisfy the people below, in keeping with my purpose of punishing wrongdoing and bringing peace to the people.

sentences.zh: 不恭命者，罰無赦。

translations.literal: Whoever does not respect the command—punishment without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever disobeys this order will be punished without mercy.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，命馮勝留守開封。

translations.literal: ” On the day bingshen, Feng Sheng was ordered to remain and guard Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingshen, Feng Sheng was ordered to remain and guard Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，至自開封。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day dingwei, he returned from Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingwei, he returned from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 己酉，徐達會諸將兵於臨清。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Xu Da assembled the generals’ troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Xu Da gathered the generals’ forces at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，常遇春克德州。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Chang Yuchun captured Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Chang Yuchun took Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，克通州，元帝趨上都。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Tongzhou was captured; the Yuan emperor fled toward Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Tongzhou fell; the Yuan emperor fled toward Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 是月，征天下賢才為守令。

translations.literal: In this month, worthy talent throughout the realm was summoned to serve as prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: That month, worthy men from across the empire were recruited as prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 免吳江、慶德、太平、甯國、滁、和被災田租。

translations.literal: Land tax was remitted for Wu, Qingde, Taiping, Ningguo, Chu, and He prefectures where disaster had struck.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken areas in Wu, Qingde, Taiping, Ningguo, Chu, and He prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，以應天為南京，開封為北京。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jisi, Yingtian was made Southern Capital and Kaifeng Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, Yingtian was designated the Southern Capital and Kaifeng the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，徐達入元都，封府庫圖籍，守宮門，禁士卒侵暴，遣將巡古北口諸隘。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the treasuries and archives, guarded the palace gates, forbade soldiers from violence and plunder, and dispatched generals to patrol the passes at Gubeikou and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the treasuries and archives, guarded the palace gates, forbade soldiers from looting, and sent generals to patrol the passes at Gubeikou and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以京師火，四方水旱，詔中書省集議便民事。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, because of fire in the capital and flood and drought in the four quarters, an edict ordered the Secretariat to assemble and discuss measures convenient for the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, because of fire in the capital and floods and droughts across the realm, he ordered the Secretariat to discuss measures to ease the people’s burdens.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定六部官制。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the official system of the Six Ministries was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the bureaucratic structure of the Six Ministries was established.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞劉基致仕。

translations.literal: The censor-in-chief Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Liu Ji retired from office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，赦殊死以下。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, amnesty was granted below the death penalty for extraordinary crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, he granted amnesty for all crimes short of capital offenses requiring extraordinary punishment.

sentences.zh: 將士從征者恤其家，逋逃許自首。

translations.literal: Families of officers and soldiers on campaign were given relief; fugitives were permitted to surrender themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Families of officers and soldiers on campaign were given relief, and deserters were allowed to surrender.

sentences.zh: 新克州郡毋妄殺。

translations.literal: In newly captured prefectures and districts, killing without cause was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In newly taken prefectures and districts, indiscriminate killing was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 輸賦道遠者，官為轉運，災荒以實聞。

translations.literal: Where tax transport was distant, officials would transfer it; in cases of disaster and famine, reports were to state the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Where tax grain had to travel long distances, officials would arrange transport; disaster reports were to reflect actual conditions.

sentences.zh: 免鎮江租稅。

translations.literal: Land tax in Zhenjiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax in Zhenjiang was remitted.

sentences.zh: 避亂民復業者，聽墾荒地，復三年。

translations.literal: People who had fled the turmoil and returned to their occupations were permitted to reclaim wasteland and were exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees who returned to their occupations were allowed to reclaim wasteland with a three-year tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 衍聖公襲封及授曲阜知縣，並如前代制。

translations.literal: The Duke of Yansheng was enfeoffed in succession, and a magistrate of Qufu was appointed, all according to the regulations of previous dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Yansheng was enfeoffed in succession, and a magistrate of Qufu was appointed, all as under previous dynasties.

sentences.zh: 有司以禮聘致賢士，學校毋事虛文。

translations.literal: Officials were to invite worthy scholars according to ritual; schools were not to engage in empty formalities.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials were to invite worthy scholars with proper ceremony; schools were not to traffic in empty formalities.

sentences.zh: 平刑，毋非時決囚。

translations.literal: Punishments were to be evened; prisoners were not to be executed out of season.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments were to be applied fairly, and prisoners were not to be executed out of season.

sentences.zh: 除書籍田器稅，民間逋負免征。

translations.literal: Tax on books, records, fields, and tools was abolished; private arrears in tax were not to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on books, records, fields, and tools were abolished, and private tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 蒙古、色目人有才能者，許擢用。

translations.literal: Mongols and Semu persons of ability were permitted to be promoted and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Talented Mongols and Semu were permitted to be promoted and employed.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨廢疾者，存恤之。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled, and the infirm were to be supported and cared for.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled, and the infirm were to be supported and cared for.

sentences.zh: 民年七十以上，一子復。

translations.literal: People seventy years of age and above had one son exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: For people seventy years of age and above, one son was exempted from corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 他利害當興革不在詔內者，有司具以聞。

translations.literal: Other benefits and harms that should be instituted or abolished and were not within the edict—officials were to report them in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Other measures for the people’s benefit or harm not covered in the edict were to be reported in full by officials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸北京。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the emperor visited the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the emperor went to the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 改大都路曰北平府。

translations.literal: The Dadu circuit was changed to Beiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu circuit was redesignated Beiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 征元故臣。

translations.literal: Former Yuan officials were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Former Yuan officials were summoned to serve.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔徐達、常遇春取山西。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, an edict ordered Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to take Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, he ordered Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to take Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，放元宮人。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, palace women of the Yuan were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Yuan palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，詔曰：「天下之治，天下之賢共理之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guihai, an edict said: “The ordering of the realm is governed jointly by the worthy of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai, an edict said: “The good ordering of the empire is a task the empire’s worthies must share.

sentences.zh: 今賢士多隱岩穴，豈有司失於敦勸歟，朝廷疏於禮待歟，抑朕寡昧不足致賢，將在位者壅蔽使不上達歟？

translations.literal: Now many worthy scholars hide in caves and cliffs—is it that the officials have failed in earnest encouragement, that the court has been remiss in ritual courtesy, that I am deficient and unable to attract the worthy, or that those in office have blocked them so they cannot reach me?
translations.idiomatic: Yet many worthy scholars still hide in seclusion—is it that officials have failed to encourage them earnestly, that the court has been remiss in courtesy, that I lack the virtue to attract talent, or that those in office have blocked them from reaching me?

sentences.zh: 不然，賢士大夫，幼學壯行，豈甘沒世而已哉。

translations.literal: If not so, worthy scholar-officials who studied in youth and acted with integrity in maturity—how could they be content to die unknown?
translations.idiomatic: If not, how could worthy scholar-officials who studied in youth and served with integrity be content to die in obscurity?

sentences.zh: 天下甫定，朕願與諸儒講明治道。

translations.literal: The realm has only just been settled; I wish to discuss with the various Confucians the ordering of government by enlightened principles.
translations.idiomatic: The realm has only just been pacified; I wish to discuss enlightened governance with the Confucian scholars.

sentences.zh: 有能輔朕濟民者，有司禮遣。

translations.literal: Whoever can assist me in bringing benefit to the people—let the officials escort him with ritual courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever can assist me in benefiting the people—let officials escort him here with due ceremony.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，常遇春下保定，遂下真定。

translations.literal: ” On the day yichou, Chang Yuchun reduced Baoding and then reduced Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: ” On yichou, Chang Yuchun took Baoding and then took Zhending.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，馮勝、湯和下懷慶，澤、潞相繼下。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day gengwu, Feng Sheng and Tang He reduced Huaqing; Ze and Lu fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu, Feng Sheng and Tang He took Huaqing; Ze and Lu fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，至自北京。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, he returned from the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, he returned from the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以元都平，詔天下。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, because the Yuan capital had been pacified, an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, with the Yuan capital pacified, he issued an edict to the realm.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，遣使分行天下，訪求賢才。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jihai, envoys were dispatched in separate routes throughout the realm to seek worthy talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jihai, envoys were sent throughout the realm to seek worthy talent.

sentences.zh: 庚子，始祀上帝於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, sacrifice to the Supreme Lord was first performed at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, sacrifice to the Supreme Lord was first performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔劉基還。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, an edict recalled Liu Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, an edict recalled Liu Ji to office.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，徐達克太原，擴廓帖木兒走甘肅，山西平。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingmao, Xu Da captured Taiyuan; Köke Temür fled to Gansu, and Shanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, Xu Da took Taiyuan; Köke Temür fled to Gansu, and Shanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置登聞鼓。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Petition Drum was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Petition Drum was installed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以書諭明昇。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, a letter was sent instructing Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he sent a letter instructing Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙巳，立功臣廟於雞籠山。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, the first month, on the day yisi, a temple to meritorious officials was established on Jilong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, the first month, on yisi, a temple to meritorious officials was established on Jilong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he performed the seasonal sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he performed the seasonal sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔曰：「朕淮右布衣，因天下亂，率眾渡江，保民圖治，今十有五年。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, an edict said: “I, a commoner of the Huai right, because the realm was in turmoil, led the masses across the river to protect the people and seek good government; now it has been fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, an edict said: “I was a commoner of the Huai region; when the realm fell into turmoil I led my followers across the Yangzi to protect the people and seek good government, and fifteen years have now passed.

sentences.zh: 荷天眷祐，悉皆戡定。

translations.literal: Bearing Heaven’s gracious protection, all were brought to settlement.
translations.idiomatic: By Heaven’s favor, all has been brought to order.

sentences.zh: 用是命將北征，齊魯之民饋糧給軍，不憚千里。

translations.literal: Therefore I ordered the generals on a northern campaign; the people of Qi and Lu supplied grain to the army without shrinking from a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I ordered a northern campaign; the people of Qi and Lu supplied the army with grain, traveling a thousand li without complaint.

sentences.zh: 朕軫厥勞，已免元年田租。

translations.literal: I have been solicitous of their toil and have already remitted the land tax of the inaugural year.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of their labor, I have already remitted the inaugural year’s land tax.

sentences.zh: 遭旱民未蘇，其更賜一年。

translations.literal: The people have not yet recovered from drought; let them be granted another year’s remission.
translations.idiomatic: Because drought has left the people unrecovered, they are granted another year’s remission.

sentences.zh: 頃者大軍平燕都，下晉、冀，民被兵燹，困征斂，北平、燕南、河東、山西今年田租亦與蠲免。

translations.literal: Recently the great army pacified Yan capital and reduced Jin and Ji; the people suffered from warfare and were distressed by levies—Beiping, southern Yan, Hedong, and Shanxi shall also have this year’s land tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the great army recently pacified the Yan capital and took Jin and Ji, the people suffered from warfare and crushing levies; land tax for this year in Beiping, southern Yan, Hedong, and Shanxi is likewise remitted.

sentences.zh: 河南諸郡歸附，久欲惠之，西北未平，師過其地，是以未遑。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Henan submitted long ago, and I have long wished to show them favor; the northwest was not yet settled, and the army passed through their territory, so there was no leisure.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Henan submitted long ago and I have long wished to favor them, but the northwest was not yet pacified and armies passed through on campaign, so I had no leisure until now.

sentences.zh: 今晉、冀平矣，西抵潼關，北界大河，南至唐、鄧、光、息，今年稅糧悉除之。

translations.literal: Now Jin and Ji are pacified, west to Tong Pass, north to the Great River, south to Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi—all this year’s tax grain is completely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Jin and Ji are pacified, from the west at Tong Pass to the Great River in the north and Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi in the south, all tax grain for this year is abolished.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「應天、太平、鎮江、宣城、廣德供億浩穰。

translations.literal: ” Another edict said: “Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde supply provisions in great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: ” Another edict said: “Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde bear a heavy burden of supply.

sentences.zh: 去歲蠲租，遇旱惠不及下。

translations.literal: Last year’s tax remission, encountering drought, did not reach the lowest levels.
translations.idiomatic: Last year’s remission, combined with drought, did not reach the common people as intended.

sentences.zh: 其再免諸郡及無為州今年租稅。

translations.literal: Let these several prefectures and Wuwei Prefecture again be exempted from this year’s rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: These prefectures and Wuwei Prefecture are again exempted from this year’s rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，常遇春取大同。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Chang Yuchun took Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Chang Yuchun took Datong.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東濱海郡縣。

translations.literal: In this month, Wo pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔，詔修元史。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, bingyin, an edict ordered the compilation of the History of Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the first day of the second month, an edict ordered compilation of the History of Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，徐達至奉元，張思道遁。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengzi, Xu Da reached Fengyuan; Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, Xu Da reached Fengyuan; Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 振陝西饑，戶米三石。

translations.literal: Relief was extended for famine in Shaanxi—three piculs of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was granted in Shaanxi at three piculs of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 丙午，常遇春至鳳翔，李思齊奔臨洮。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang; Li Siqi fled to Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang; Li Siqi fled to Lintao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，遇春還師北平。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day bingyin, Yuchun returned his army to Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingyin, Chang Yuchun returned his army to Beiping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，諸王子受經於博士孔克仁。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the various princes received the classics from Erudite Kong Keren.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the imperial princes began studying the classics under Erudite Kong Keren.

sentences.zh: 令功臣子弟入學。

translations.literal: The sons of meritorious officials were ordered to enter the schools.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of meritorious officials were ordered to enter the schools.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，編《祖訓錄》，定封建諸王之制。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Records of Ancestral Instruction were compiled and the system of enfeoffing feudal princes was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Records of Ancestral Instruction was compiled and the system of enfeoffing imperial princes was established.

sentences.zh: 徐達下鞏昌。

translations.literal: Xu Da reduced Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da took Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜秦、隴新附州縣稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, tax grain was granted to the newly submitted prefectures and counties of Qin and Long.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, tax grain was granted to the newly submitted prefectures and counties of Qin and Long.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，馮勝至臨洮，李思齊降。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Feng Sheng reached Lintao; Li Siqi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Feng Sheng reached Lintao; Li Siqi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，徐達襲破元豫王於西寧。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Xu Da made a surprise attack and defeated the Yuan Prince of Yu at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xu Da surprised and defeated the Yuan Prince of Yu at Xining.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day jiawu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first day jiawu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，徐達下平涼、延安。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Xu Da reduced Pingliang and Yan’an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Xu Da took Pingliang and Yan’an.

sentences.zh: 張良臣以慶陽降，尋叛。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangchen surrendered with Qingyang but soon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangchen surrendered Qingyang but soon rebelled.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，始祀地於方丘。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, sacrifice to Earth was first performed at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, sacrifice to Earth was first performed at the Square Mound.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，常遇春克開平，元帝北走。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jimao, Chang Yuchun captured Kaiping; the Yuan emperor fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, Chang Yuchun took Kaiping; the Yuan emperor fled north.

sentences.zh: 壬午，封陳日煃為安南國王。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Chen Rikui was enfeoffed as king of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Chen Rikui was enfeoffed as king of Annan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，鄂國公常遇春卒於軍，詔李文忠領其眾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jihai, Duke of Eguo Chang Yuchun died in the army; an edict ordered Li Wenzhong to command his forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jihai, Duke of E Chang Yuchun died on campaign; Li Wenzhong was ordered to take command of his forces.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，擴廓帖木兒遣將破原州、涇州。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Köke Temür dispatched generals who captured Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Köke Temür sent generals who took Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，馮勝擊走之。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Feng Sheng attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Feng Sheng attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，明昇遣使來。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Ming Sheng sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Ming Sheng sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，元兵攻大同，李文忠擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Yuan troops attacked Datong; Li Wenzhong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin, Yuan troops attacked Datong; Li Wenzhong defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，定內侍官制。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the palace eunuch official system was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the bureaucratic system for palace eunuchs was established.

sentences.zh: 諭吏部曰：「內臣但備使令，毋多人，古來若輩擅權，可為鑒戒。

translations.literal: He instructed the Ministry of Personnel, saying: “Palace attendants are only to carry out orders—do not employ many. Throughout history men of this sort have usurped power; this may serve as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: He told the Ministry of Personnel: “Palace attendants exist only to carry out orders—do not employ many. Throughout history such men have seized power; let that be a warning.

sentences.zh: 馭之之道，當使之畏法，勿令有功，有功則驕恣矣。

translations.literal: The way to control them is to make them fear the law; do not let them achieve merit—for merit leads to arrogance and license.
translations.idiomatic: The way to control them is to make them fear the law; do not let them earn merit, for merit breeds arrogance and license.

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，《元史》成。

translations.literal: ” On the day guiyou, the History of Yuan was completed.
translations.idiomatic: ” On guiyou, the History of Yuan was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封王顓為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，徐達克慶陽，斬張良臣，陝西平。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Xu Da captured Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and Shaanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Xu Da took Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and pacified Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，命儒臣纂禮書。

translations.literal: In this month, Confucian officials were ordered to compile ritual books.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Confucian officials were ordered to compile books of ritual.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，召徐達、湯和還，馮勝留總軍事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinchou, Xu Da and Tang He were recalled; Feng Sheng remained to command military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou, Xu Da and Tang He were recalled; Feng Sheng remained in overall command.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以臨濠為中都。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Linhuo was made the central capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Linhuo was designated the central capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，征南師還。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the southern campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the southern campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，遣楊璟諭明昇。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day renxu, Yang Jing was dispatched to instruct Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renxu, Yang Jing was sent to instruct Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，甘露降於鐘山，群臣請告廟，不許。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, sweet dew fell on Zhong Mountain; the ministers requested to report it at the temple, but this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, sweet dew fell on Zhong Mountain; the ministers asked to report it at the ancestral temple, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔天下郡縣立學。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict ordered schools established in every prefecture and county throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an edict ordered schools established in every prefecture and county in the empire.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使貽元帝書。

translations.literal: In this month, envoys were dispatched bearing a letter to the Yuan emperor.
translations.idiomatic: That month, envoys were sent with a letter to the Yuan emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，祀上帝於圜丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yisi, the Supreme Lord was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound, with Renzu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yisi, sacrifice to the Supreme Lord was performed at the Circular Mound, with Renzu as associate.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，封阿答阿者為占城國王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, A Da A Zhe was enfeoffed as king of Champa.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, A Da A Zhe was enfeoffed as king of Champa.

sentences.zh: 甲申，振西安諸府饑，戶米二石。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, famine in the prefectures of Xi’an was relieved—two piculs of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, famine relief was granted in the Xi’an prefectures at two piculs of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大賚平定中原及征南將士。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, great rewards were bestowed on the officers and soldiers who had pacified the central plains and those of the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, lavish rewards were granted to the officers and soldiers who had pacified the central plains and the southern campaign forces.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，擴廓帖木兒攻蘭州，指揮於光死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou; Commander Yu Guang died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou; Commander Yu Guang died in battle.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Champa, Annan, and Goryeo presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Annan, and Goryeo sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸巳，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，分道北征。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, the first month, on the day guisi, Xu Da was made great general for the campaign against the barbarians; Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He were his deputies, and in separate columns they campaigned north.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, the first month, on guisi, Xu Da was appointed great general for the northern campaign; Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He served as his deputies and marched north in separate columns.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，追封郭子興滁陽王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guiwei, Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiwei, Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔求賢才可任六部者。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, an edict sought worthy talent capable of serving in the Six Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, an edict sought worthy talent fit to serve in the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 是月，李文忠下興和，進兵察罕腦兒，執元平章竹貞。

translations.literal: In this month, Li Wenzhong reduced Xinghe, advanced to Chaghan Nawr, and seized the Yuan vice minister Zhuzhen.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Li Wenzhong took Xinghe, advanced to Chaghan Nawr, and captured the Yuan vice minister Zhuzhen.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，免南畿、河南、山東、北平、浙東、江西廣信、饒州今年田租。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengyin, this year’s land tax was remitted for the southern capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhe, Guangxin in Jiangxi, and Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, this year’s land tax was remitted for the southern capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhejiang, Guangxin in Jiangxi, and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，封皇子樉為秦王，棡晉王，棣燕王，橚吳王，楨楚王，榑齊王，梓潭王，杞趙王，檀魯王，從孫守謙靖江王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yichou, the princes were enfeoffed: Shu as Prince of Qin, Gang as Prince of Jin, Di as Prince of Yan, Su as Prince of Wu, Zhen as Prince of Chu, Gui as Prince of Qi, Zi as Prince of Tan, Qi as Prince of Zhao, Tan as Prince of Lu, and the emperor’s grandnephew Shouqian as Prince of Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou, the princes were enfeoffed: Shu as Prince of Qin, Gang as Prince of Jin, Di as Prince of Yan, Su as Prince of Wu, Zhen as Prince of Chu, Gui as Prince of Qi, Zi as Prince of Tan, Qi as Prince of Zhao, Tan as Prince of Lu, and the emperor’s grandnephew Shouqian as Prince of Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 徐達大破擴廓帖木兒於沈兒峪，盡降其眾，擴廓走和林。

translations.literal: Xu Da greatly defeated Köke Temür at Shen’er Valley, completely accepting the surrender of his host; Köke fled to Khara Khoto / Karakorum (Hélin).
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da routed Köke Temür at Shen’er Valley and accepted the surrender of his entire force; Köke fled to Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，元帝崩於應昌，子愛猷識理達臘嗣。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang; his son Ayushiridara succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang; his son Ayushiridara succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 是月，慈利土官覃垕作亂。

translations.literal: In this month, the native official of Cili, Qin Huan, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the native official of Cili, Qin Huan, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，徐達取興元。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, Xu Da took Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jichou, Xu Da took Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 分遣鄧愈招諭吐蕃。

translations.literal: Deng Yu was separately dispatched to summon and instruct the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu was separately dispatched to summon and win over the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔守令舉學識篤行之士。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered prefects and magistrates to recommend scholars of solid learning and upright conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, an edict ordered prefects and magistrates to recommend scholars of solid learning and upright conduct.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設科取士。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the civil service examination was instituted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the civil service examination system was instituted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠克應昌。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 元嗣君北走，獲其子買的裏八剌，降五萬餘人，窮追至北慶州，不及而還。

translations.literal: The Yuan successor fled north; his son Maidiliba’er was captured, more than fifty thousand surrendered, and pursuit was pressed to northern Qingzhou but did not overtake them before returning.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan successor fled north; his son Maidiliba’er was captured, more than fifty thousand men surrendered, and the pursuers chased as far as northern Qingzhou but turned back without overtaking him.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔行大射禮。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, an edict ordered the great archery rite to be performed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, an edict ordered performance of the great archery rite.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀地於方丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound, with Renzu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, sacrifice to Earth was performed at the Square Mound, with Renzu as associate.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，徐達下興元。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Xu Da reduced Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Xu Da took Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 鄧愈克河州。

translations.literal: Deng Yu captured Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu took Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔開國時將帥無嗣者祿其家。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered that where founding generals and commanders left no heirs, their households were to receive stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, an edict ordered stipends for households of founding generals who left no heirs.

sentences.zh: 是月旱，齋戒，後妃親執爨，皇太子諸王饋於齋所。

translations.literal: In this month there was drought; he observed fasting and purification, the empress and consorts personally tended the cooking fires, and the crown prince and princes presented food at the fasting hall.
translations.idiomatic: That month a drought prompted fasting and purification; the empress and consorts cooked in person, and the crown prince and princes brought food to the fasting hall.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，素服草屨，步禱山川壇，露宿凡三日，還齋於西廡。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, wuwu, wearing plain clothes and straw sandals, he walked to pray at the mountain and river altars, sleeping in the open for three days in all, then returned to fast in the western gallery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the first day of the sixth month, dressed in plain clothes and straw sandals, he walked to pray at the mountain and river altars, sleeping in the open for three days before returning to fast in the western gallery.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賚將士，省獄囚，命有司訪求通經術明治道者。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, officers and soldiers were rewarded, prisoners were reviewed, and officials were ordered to seek out those versed in the classics and skilled in enlightened governance.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, he rewarded officers and soldiers, reviewed prisoners, and ordered officials to seek men versed in the classics and skilled in enlightened governance.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大雨。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李文忠捷奏至，命仕元者勿賀。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Li Wenzhong’s victory report arrived; an order was issued that those who had served the Yuan were not to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Li Wenzhong’s victory report arrived; the emperor ordered that former Yuan officials were not to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 諡元主曰順帝。

translations.literal: The Yuan ruler was given the posthumous title Emperor Shun.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，買的裏八剌至京師，群臣請獻俘。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Maidiliba’er reached the capital; the ministers requested to present captives.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Maidiliba’er reached the capital; the ministers asked to present him as a captive.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「武王伐殷用之乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: “When King Wu attacked Yin, did he do this?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: “When King Wu attacked the Shang, did he do this?

sentences.zh: 」省臣以唐太宗嘗行之對。

translations.literal: ” The Secretariat officials answered that Emperor Taizong of Tang had once done so.
translations.idiomatic: ” The Secretariat officials replied that Emperor Taizong of Tang had once done so.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「太宗是待王世充耳。

translations.literal: The emperor said: “Taizong was dealing with Wang Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: “Taizong was dealing with Wang Shichong.

sentences.zh: 若遇隋之子孫，恐不爾也。

translations.literal: Had he encountered a descendant of the Sui, I fear he would not have acted thus.
translations.idiomatic: Had he been facing a descendant of the Sui, I doubt he would have done the same.

sentences.zh: 」遂不許。

translations.literal: ” He thereupon did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: ” He thereupon refused.

sentences.zh: 又以捷奏多侈辭，謂宰相曰：「元主中國百年，朕與卿等父母皆賴其生養，奈何為此浮薄之言？

translations.literal: Also, because the victory reports contained much inflated language, he told the chief ministers: “The Yuan ruler held China for a hundred years; I and you—our parents all relied on him for their livelihood. How can you use such shallow and frivolous words?
translations.idiomatic: Because the victory reports were full of inflated language, he told the chief ministers: “The Yuan ruled China for a century; our parents all lived under their protection. How can you write in such shallow and boastful terms?

sentences.zh: 亟改之。

translations.literal: Change them at once.
translations.idiomatic: Change them at once.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，封買的裏八剌為崇禮侯。

translations.literal: ” On the day yihai, Maidiliba’er was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chongli.
translations.idiomatic: ” On yihai, Maidiliba’er was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chongli.

sentences.zh: 丙子，告捷於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, victory was reported at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, victory was reported at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，告太廟，詔示天下。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, victory was reported at the Grand Temple, and an edict was promulgated to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, victory was reported at the Grand Temple, and an edict was issued to the realm.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徙蘇州、松江、嘉興、湖州、杭州民無業者田臨濠，給資糧牛種，復三年。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, people without occupations from Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou were relocated to farm fields at Linhuo; provisions, grain, cattle, and seed were supplied, with remission for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, unemployed people from Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou were resettled to farm at Linhuo, given provisions, grain, cattle, and seed, with a three-year tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東、浙江、福建濱海州縣。

translations.literal: In this month, Wo pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties in Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，明昇將吳友仁寇漢中，參政傅友德擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingchen, Ming Sheng’s general Wu Youren attacked Hanzhong; Administrative Commissioner Fu Youde repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, Ming Sheng’s general Wu Youren attacked Hanzhong; Administrative Commissioner Fu Youde drove them back.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞楊憲有罪誅。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Grand Councilor Yang Xian was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Grand Councilor Yang Xian was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，遣使瘞中原遺骸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiyou, envoys were dispatched to bury the scattered bones of the central plains.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, envoys were sent to bury the scattered bones of the central plains.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，詔儒士更直午門，為武臣講經史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingchen, an edict ordered Confucian scholars to take rotating duty at the Meridian Gate to lecture military officials on the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingchen, an edict ordered Confucian scholars to take rotating duty at the Meridian Gate to lecture military officials on the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，周德興為征南將軍，討覃垕，垕遁。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhou Dexing was made southern campaigning general to attack Qin Huan; Huan fled.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhou Dexing was appointed southern campaigning general to attack Qin Huan; Huan fled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，北征師還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renchen, the northern campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, the northern campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，告武成於郊廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, martial accomplishment was reported at the suburban temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, martial accomplishment was reported at the suburban temples.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大封功臣。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, meritorious officials were enfeoffed on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the meritorious officials received major enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 進李善長韓國公，徐達魏國公，封李文忠曹國公，馮勝宋國公，鄧愈衛國公，常遇春子茂鄭國公，湯和等侯者二十八人。

translations.literal: Li Shanchang was advanced to Duke of Han, Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong was enfeoffed Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, Deng Yu Duke of Wei; Chang Yuchun’s son Mao was enfeoffed Duke of Zheng; Tang He and others were enfeoffed as marquises—twenty-eight men in all.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang was promoted to Duke of Han and Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong was made Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, and Deng Yu Duke of Wei; Chang Yuchun’s son Mao was made Duke of Zheng; Tang He and twenty-seven others were made marquises.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設壇親祭戰沒將士。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, an altar was set up and he personally sacrificed to officers and soldiers who had died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, he set up an altar and personally sacrificed to officers and soldiers killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, there was a ceremony at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, sacrifice was performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔戶部置戶籍、戶帖，歲計登耗以聞，著為令。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish household registers and household placards; annual increases and decreases were to be reported, and this was enacted as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish household registers and household placards, with annual gains and losses reported to the throne, and this was enacted as law.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封中書右丞汪廣洋忠勤伯，御史中丞劉基誠意伯。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Right Assistant Grand Councilor Wang Guangyang was enfeoffed as Earl of Zhongqin, and Censor-in-chief Liu Ji as Earl of Chengyi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Right Assistant Grand Councilor Wang Guangyang was enfeoffed as Earl of Zhongqin and Censor-in-chief Liu Ji as Earl of Chengyi.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，復貽元嗣君書，並諭和林諸部。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guihai, a letter was again sent to the Yuan successor, and the various tribes of Karakorum were also instructed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guihai, another letter was sent to the Yuan successor, with instructions also to the tribes of Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 甲子，建奉先殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Hall for Venerating Ancestors was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Hall for Venerating Ancestors was built.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使祭歷代帝王陵寢，並加修葺。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mausoleums of emperors of successive dynasties, which were also repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tombs of emperors of successive dynasties and to repair them.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜勳臣田。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, fields were granted to meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, fields were granted to meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以正月至是月，日中屢有黑子，詔廷臣言得失。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, because from the first month to this month black spots repeatedly appeared on the sun at midday, an edict ordered court officials to speak of gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, because black sunspots had repeatedly appeared at midday since the first month, the emperor ordered court officials to discuss what had gone right and wrong in government.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、西洋入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙戌，李善長罷，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on the day bingxu, Li Shanchang was dismissed and Wang Guangyang made right chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on bingxu, Li Shanchang was dismissed and Wang Guangyang appointed right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中山侯湯和為征西將軍，江夏侯周德興、德慶侯廖永忠副之，率舟師由瞿塘，潁川侯傅友德為征虜前將軍，濟甯侯顧時副之，率步騎由秦隴伐蜀。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Marquis of Zhongshan Tang He was made western campaigning general, with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Deqing Liao Yongzhong as deputies, leading the fleet through Qutang; Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde was made front general for the campaign against the barbarians, with Marquis of Jining Gu Shi as deputy, leading infantry and cavalry through Qin and Long to attack Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Marquis of Zhongshan Tang He was appointed western campaigning general, with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Deqing Liao Yongzhong as deputies, to lead the fleet through Qutang; Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde was appointed front general for the northern campaign, with Marquis of Jining Gu Shi as deputy, to lead infantry and cavalry through Qin and Long against Shu.

sentences.zh: 魏國公徐達練兵北平。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Xu Da trained troops at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wei Xu Da drilled troops at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，衛國公鄧愈督餉給征蜀軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Duke of Wei Deng Yu supervised provisions for the army attacking Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Duke of Wei Deng Yu supervised supplies for the Shu campaign army.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，建郊廟於中都。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, suburban temples were built at the central capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, suburban temples were built at the central capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔設科取士，連舉三年，嗣後三年一舉。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, an edict instituted the civil examination for selecting scholars; examinations were to be held three years in succession, and thereafter once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, an edict instituted the civil examination; it was to be held three years running, and thereafter once every three years.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免山西旱災田租。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, land tax was remitted for drought disaster in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, land tax was remitted for drought-stricken areas in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，幸中都。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiaxu, the emperor visited the central capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, the emperor went to the central capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自中都。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he returned from the central capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, he returned from the central capital.

sentences.zh: 元平章劉益以遼東降。

translations.literal: The Yuan vice minister Liu Yi surrendered with Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan vice minister Liu Yi surrendered Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲太平、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: In this month, land tax was remitted for Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted for Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉朔，始策試天下貢士，賜吳伯宗等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day yiyou, the palace examination of tribute scholars throughout the realm was first held; Wu Bozong and others were granted jinshi with differing ranks of first degree and regular degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first day yiyou, the palace examination was first held for tribute scholars from across the empire; Wu Bozong and others received jinshi degrees with differing ranks.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徙山後民萬七千戶屯北平。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, seventeen thousand households of people from beyond the mountains were relocated to garrison fields at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, seventeen thousand households from beyond the mountains were resettled to garrison farms at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丁未，誠意伯劉基致仕。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Earl of Chengyi Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Earl of Chengyi Liu Ji retired from office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，傅友德克階州，文、隆、綿三州相繼下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day bingxu, Fu Youde captured Jiezhou; Wen, Long, and Mian prefectures fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingxu, Fu Youde took Jiezhou; Wen, Long, and Mian prefectures fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 五月，免江西、浙江秋糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, autumn grain tax was remitted for Jiangxi and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, autumn grain tax was remitted for Jiangxi and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，傅友德克漢州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renwu, Fu Youde captured Hanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, Fu Youde took Hanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廖永忠克夔州。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Liao Yongzhong captured Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Liao Yongzhong took Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，明昇將丁世貞破文州，守將硃顯忠死之。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Ming Sheng’s general Ding Shizhen captured Wenzhou; the defending general Zhu Xianzhong died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Ming Sheng’s general Ding Shizhen took Wenzhou; the defender Zhu Xianzhong was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和至重慶，明昇降。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Tang He reached Chongqing; Ming Sheng surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Tang He reached Chongqing and Ming Sheng surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊申，倭寇膠州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Wo pirates raided Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Japanese pirates raided Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，徙山後民三萬五千戶於內地，又徙沙漠遺民三萬二千戶屯田北平。

translations.literal: In this month, thirty-five thousand households of people from beyond the mountains were relocated to the interior; another thirty-two thousand households of desert remnant people were relocated to garrison fields at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: That month, thirty-five thousand households from beyond the mountains were resettled inland, and another thirty-two thousand households of desert remnant peoples were settled on garrison farms at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，徐達練兵山西。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinhai, Xu Da trained troops in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai, Xu Da drilled troops in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，傅友德下成都，四川平。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Fu Youde reduced Chengdu; Sichuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Fu Youde took Chengdu and pacified Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，明昇至京師，封歸義侯。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Ming Sheng reached the capital; he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Guiyi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Ming Sheng reached the capital and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Guiyi.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，免中都、淮、揚及泰、滁、無為田租。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiawu, land tax was remitted for the central capital, Huai, Yang, and Tai, Chu, and Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, land tax was remitted for the central capital, Huai, Yang, and the prefectures of Tai, Chu, and Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 己酉，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, famine in Shaanxi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, famine relief was granted in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，高州海寇亂，通判王名善死之。

translations.literal: In this month, sea bandits rebelled in Gaozhou; Vice Commissioner Wang Mingshan died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: That month, sea bandits rebelled in Gaozhou; Vice Commissioner Wang Mingshan was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day gengxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day gengxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，征蜀師還。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingshen, the army attacking Shu returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingshen, the Shu campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingchen, there was a ceremony at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, sacrifice was performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命官吏犯贓者罪勿貸。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an order was issued that officials guilty of corruption were not to be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, an order declared that corrupt officials were not to be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西、河南被災田租。

translations.literal: In this month, land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken areas in Shaanxi and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken areas in Shaanxi and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，徐達還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、浡泥、高麗、三佛齊、暹羅、日本、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Annan, Brunei, Goryeo, Srivijaya, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Annan, Brunei, Goryeo, Srivijaya, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸丑，待制王禕使雲南，詔諭元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, the first month, on the day guichou, Attendant Drafter Wang Wei was sent to Yunnan with an edict instructing the Yuan Liang prince Basalawarmi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, spring, the first month, on guichou, Attendant Drafter Wang Wei was sent to Yunnan to instruct the Yuan Liang prince Basalawarmi.

sentences.zh: 禕至，不屈死。

translations.literal: When Wei arrived, he would not submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei arrived, he refused to submit and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，徙陳理、明升於高麗。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Chen Li and Ming Sheng were relocated to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Chen Li and Ming Sheng were relocated to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魏國公徐達為征虜大將軍，出雁門，趨和林，曹國公李文忠為左副將軍，出應昌，宋國公馮勝為征西將軍，取甘肅，征擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Duke of Wei Xu Da was made great general for the campaign against the barbarians, going out through Yanmen and pressing toward Karakorum; Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong was made left deputy general, going out through Yingchang; Duke of Song Feng Sheng was made western campaigning general to take Gansu and campaign against Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Duke of Wei Xu Da was appointed great general for the northern campaign, marching out through Yanmen toward Karakorum; Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong was left deputy general, marching out through Yingchang; Duke of Song Feng Sheng was western campaigning general to take Gansu and campaign against Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎督海運，餉遼東。

translations.literal: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen supervised sea transport to supply Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen supervised maritime transport to supply Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 衛國公鄧愈為征南將軍，江夏侯周德興、江陰侯吳良副之，分道討湖南、廣西洞蠻。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Deng Yu was made southern campaigning general, with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Jiangyin Wu Liang as deputies, campaigning in separate columns against the cave barbarians of Hunan and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wei Deng Yu was appointed southern campaigning general, with Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing and Marquis of Jiangyin Wu Liang as deputies, to campaign in separate columns against the cave peoples of Hunan and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，安南陳叔明弒其主日熞自立，遣使入貢，卻之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day bingxu, Chen Shuming of Annan murdered his lord Ri Kiet and installed himself, sending envoys with tribute; this was declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingxu, Chen Shuming of Annan murdered his lord Ri Kiet, seized power, and sent a tribute mission, which was refused.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，都督僉事藍玉敗擴廓於土剌河。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingmao, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Köke Temür on the Tula River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Köke Temür on the Tula River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，振濟南、萊州饑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jimao, famine in Jinan and Laizhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jimao, famine relief was granted in Jinan and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，始行鄉飲酒禮。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the village drinking ceremony was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the village drinking ceremony was first performed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈平散毛諸洞蠻。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Deng Yu pacified the cave barbarians of Sanmao and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Deng Yu pacified the cave peoples of Sanmao and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，徐達及元兵戰於嶺北，敗績。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renzi, Xu Da fought Yuan troops north of the ranges and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, Xu Da fought Yuan troops north of the ranges and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔曰：「天下大定，禮儀風俗不可不正。

translations.literal: In this month, an edict said: “All-under-Heaven is greatly settled; ritual and custom must be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict said: “The empire is now largely settled; ritual and custom must be set right.

sentences.zh: 諸遭亂為人奴隸者復為民。

translations.literal: All who in the turmoil had become others’ slaves were restored to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: All who had been enslaved during the turmoil were restored to free commoner status.

sentences.zh: 凍餒者里中富室假貸之，孤寡殘疾者官養之，毋失所。

translations.literal: Those suffering cold and hunger were to be lent to by wealthy households in the lane; orphans, widows, the solitary, and the disabled were to be supported by officials so that none were left without support.
translations.idiomatic: Those suffering cold and hunger were to be lent to by wealthy households in their communities; orphans, widows, the solitary, and the disabled were to be supported by officials so that none were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 鄉黨論齒，相見揖拜，毋違禮。

translations.literal: In the village, age was discussed in precedence; on meeting, bowing and saluting were performed—do not violate ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In villages, precedence was to follow age; on meeting, people were to bow and salute according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 婚姻毋論財。

translations.literal: In marriage, do not discuss wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Marriage was not to turn on wealth.

sentences.zh: 喪事稱家有無，毋惑陰陽拘忌，停柩暴露。

translations.literal: In funerals, expenditure was to match the family’s means; do not be misled by yin-yang taboos and leave coffins exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Funerals were to suit the family’s means; people were not to be misled by yin-yang taboos into leaving coffins exposed.

sentences.zh: 流民復業者各就丁力耕種，毋以舊田為限。

translations.literal: Wandering people returning to their occupations were each to cultivate according to their labor power; the old fields were not to be taken as the limit.
translations.idiomatic: Returning refugees were to farm according to their labor capacity, without being limited to their former holdings.

sentences.zh: 僧道齋醮雜男女，恣飲食，有司嚴治之。

translations.literal: Buddhist and Daoist fasting rites mixing men and women and indulging in food and drink were to be strictly punished by officials.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist and Daoist rites that mixed men and women and indulged in feasting were to be strictly punished.

sentences.zh: 閩、粵豪家毋閹人子為火者，犯者抵罪。

translations.literal: In Fujian and Guangdong, powerful families were forbidden to castrate boys as “fire servants”; violators were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In Fujian and Guangdong, powerful families were forbidden to castrate boys as household servants; violators were punished by law.

sentences.zh: 」六月丙子，定宦官禁令。

translations.literal: ” In the sixth month, on the day bingzi, prohibitions on eunuchs were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the sixth month, on bingzi, prohibitions governing eunuchs were established.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定宮官女職之制。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the system of palace women’s offices was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the system of palace women’s offices was established.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，馮勝克甘肅，追敗元兵於瓜、沙州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Feng Sheng captured Gansu and pursued and defeated Yuan troops at Guazhou and Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Feng Sheng took Gansu and pursued and defeated Yuan troops at Guazhou and Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，定六部職掌及歲終考績法。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the duties of the Six Ministries and the year-end performance review law were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the duties of the Six Ministries and the year-end performance review system were established.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吳良平靖州蠻。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠敗元兵於阿魯渾河，宣甯侯曹良臣戰沒。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops on the Aru Hun River; Marquis of Xuanning Cao Liangchen died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops on the Aru Hun River; Marquis of Xuanning Cao Liangchen was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，作鐵榜誡功臣。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an iron tablet was made to admonish the meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an iron tablet was cast to admonish the meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 是月，振山東饑，免被災郡縣田租。

translations.literal: In this month, famine in Shandong was relieved and land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month, famine relief was granted in Shandong and land tax remitted for disaster-stricken prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，湯和及元兵戰於斷頭山，敗績。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingchen, Tang He fought Yuan troops at Duan Tou Mountain and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, Tang He fought Yuan troops at Duan Tou Mountain and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，吳良平五開、古州諸蠻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingshen, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Wukai, Guzhou, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingshen, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Wukai, Guzhou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，元兵犯雲內，同知黃里死之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Yuan troops invaded Yunnei; Vice Commissioner Huang Li died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yuan troops invaded Yunnei; Vice Commissioner Huang Li was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，周德興平婪鳳、安田諸蠻。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuwu, Zhou Dexing pacified the barbarians of Lanfeng, Antian, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, Zhou Dexing pacified the barbarians of Lanfeng, Antian, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，馮勝師還。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingyou, Feng Sheng’s army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, Feng Sheng’s army returned.

sentences.zh: 是月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德田租。

translations.literal: In this month, land tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinyou, there was a ceremony at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, sacrifice was performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 甲子，征南師還。
