translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the southern campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the southern campaign army returned.

sentences.zh: 壬申，納哈出犯遼東。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Naghachu invaded Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Naghachu invaded Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，召徐達、李文忠還。

translations.literal: In this month, Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were recalled.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔以農桑學校課有司。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, an edict ordered officials to be assessed on agriculture, sericulture, and schools.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, an edict ordered officials to be assessed on agriculture, sericulture, and schools.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命百官奏事啟皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, all officials presenting memorials were ordered to inform the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, officials presenting memorials were ordered to inform the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征西將軍，征吐番。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Deng Yu was made western campaigning general to campaign against the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Deng Yu was appointed western campaigning general to campaign against the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, a letter was sent to the Yuan successor.

sentences.zh: 是年，瑣里、占城、高麗、琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢使再至，諭自後三年一貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo tribute envoys came again; they were instructed that henceforth tribute was to be presented once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo tribute envoys came again; they were told that henceforth tribute was to be sent once every three years.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲寅，謫汪廣洋為廣東參政。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, the first month, on the day jiayin, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, spring, the first month, on jiayin, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，諭暫罷科舉，察舉賢才。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiwei, an edict ordered the civil examination temporarily suspended and worthy talent to be sought by recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, an edict suspended the civil examination temporarily and ordered worthy talent to be sought by recommendation.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命御史及按察使考察有司。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, censors and surveillance commissioners were ordered to investigate local officials.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, censors and surveillance commissioners were ordered to investigate local officials.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 頒《昭鑒錄》，訓誡諸王。

translations.literal: The Mirror for Admonition was promulgated to instruct and warn the princes.
translations.idiomatic: The Mirror for Admonition was promulgated to instruct and warn the imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太閱。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, a great military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, a great military review was held.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，備邊山西、北平。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Xu Da was made great general for the campaign against the barbarians; Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He were his deputies, guarding the borders of Shanxi and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Xu Da was appointed great general for the northern campaign; Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He served as his deputies guarding the borders of Shanxi and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 甲子，指揮使於顯為總兵官，備倭。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Commander Yu Xian was made commander-in-chief to guard against Wo pirates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Commander Yu Xian was appointed commander-in-chief to guard against Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，令有司上山川險易圖。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jichou, officials were ordered to submit maps of mountains and rivers showing difficult and easy terrain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jichou, officials were ordered to submit maps of mountains and rivers showing difficult and easy terrain.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，盱眙獻瑞麥，薦宗廟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renwu, Xuyi presented auspicious wheat, which was offered at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, Xuyi presented auspicious wheat, which was offered at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，擴廓帖木兒遣兵攻雁門，指揮吳均擊卻之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Köke Temür dispatched troops to attack Yanmen; Commander Wu Jun repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Köke Temür sent troops against Yanmen; Commander Wu Jun drove them back.

sentences.zh: 是月，免北平、河間、河南、開封、延安、汾州被災田租。

translations.literal: In this month, land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken areas in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan’an, and Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted for disaster areas in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan’an, and Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，命戶部稽渡江以來各省水旱災傷分數，優恤之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renyin, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to audit the degrees of flood and drought damage in each province since the crossing of the river, and to grant preferential relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to audit flood and drought damage in each province since the Yangzi crossing and grant preferential relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，胡惟庸為右丞相，八月乙亥，詔祀三皇及歷代帝王。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Hu Weiyong was made right chancellor. In the eighth month, on the day yihai, an edict ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and emperors of successive dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Hu Weiyong was appointed right chancellor. In the eighth month, on yihai, an edict ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and successive dynastic emperors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，召徐達、馮勝還。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinsi, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinsi, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，擴廓帖木兒犯大同，徐達遣將擊敗之，達仍留鎮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renzi, Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da dispatched generals who defeated him; Da remained to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da sent generals who defeated him and remained to garrison the area.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣兵部尚書劉仁振真定饑。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Minister of War Liu Ren was dispatched to relieve famine in Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Minister of War Liu Ren was sent to relieve famine in Zhending.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，冬至，帝不豫，改卜郊。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, at the winter solstice the emperor was unwell and the suburban sacrifice was postponed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, at the winter solstice the emperor was unwell and the suburban sacrifice was postponed.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，錄故功臣子孫未嗣者二百九人。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day yihai, two hundred nine descendants of former meritorious officials without heirs were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yihai, two hundred nine descendants of meritorious officials without heirs were registered.

sentences.zh: 壬午，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, there was a ceremony at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, sacrifice was performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，頒定《大明律》。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Great Ming Code was promulgated and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Great Ming Code was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、高麗、占城、真臘、三佛齊入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Siam, Goryeo, Champa, Zhenla, and Srivijaya presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Siam, Goryeo, Champa, Zhenla, and Srivijaya sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 命安南陳叔明權知國事。

translations.literal: Chen Shuming of Annan was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuming of Annan was authorized to administer state affairs provisionally.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌，都督僉事王簡、王誠、平章李伯升屯田河南、山東、北平。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on the day jiaxu, Regional Commanders Wang Jian and Wang Cheng and Vice Minister Li Bosheng garrisoned fields in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on jiaxu, Regional Commanders Wang Jian and Wang Cheng and Vice Minister Li Bosheng organized garrison farming in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎為總兵官，都督於顯副之，巡海捕倭。

translations.literal: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen was commander-in-chief, with Regional Commander Yu Xian as deputy, patrolling the sea to capture Wo pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen was commander-in-chief, with Regional Commander Yu Xian as deputy, patrolling the coast to capture Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the first day dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊午，修曲阜孔子廟，設孔、顏、孟三氏學。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the Confucius temple in Qufu was repaired and schools for the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Confucius temple in Qufu was repaired and schools were established for the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans.

sentences.zh: 是月，平陽、太原、汾州、曆城、汲縣旱蝗，並免租稅。

translations.literal: In this month, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Fenzhou, Licheng, and Jixian suffered drought and locusts; rent and tax were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Fenzhou, Licheng, and Jixian suffered drought and locusts; rent and tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，都督藍玉敗元兵於白酒泉，遂拔興和。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jihai, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Yuan troops at White Wine Spring and then took Xinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai, Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Yuan troops at White Wine Spring and took Xinghe.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金吾指揮陸齡討永、道諸州蠻，平之。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Golden Guard Commander Lu Ling attacked the barbarians of Yong and Dao prefectures and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Golden Guard Commander Lu Ling attacked the peoples of Yong and Dao prefectures and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，免真定等四十二禕府州縣被災田租。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingzi, land tax was remitted for forty-two prefectures and counties including Zhending that had suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingzi, land tax was remitted for forty-two disaster-stricken prefectures and counties including Zhending.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，振蘇州饑民三十萬戶。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, three hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Suzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, three hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Suzhou were given relief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，減蘇、松、嘉、湖極重田租之半。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the heaviest land tax in Su, Song, Jia, and Hu was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the heaviest land tax in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 六月，陝西平涼、延安、靖寧、鄜州雨雹，山西、山東、北平、河南蝗，並蠲田租。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Pingliang, Yan’an, Jingning, and Fuzhou in Shaanxi had hail; Shanxi, Shandong, Beiping, and Henan had locusts; land tax was all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, hail struck Pingliang, Yan’an, Jingning, and Fuzhou in Shaanxi; locusts struck Shanxi, Shandong, Beiping, and Henan; land tax was remitted in all these areas.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，李文忠破元兵於大寧、高州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiazi, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops at Daning and Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiazi, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops at Daning and Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，倭寇登、萊。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Wo pirates raided Deng and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Japanese pirates raided Deng and Lai.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午朔，祀歷代帝王廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day jiawu, sacrifice was performed at the temple of successive dynastic emperors.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the first day jiawu, sacrifice was performed at the temple of successive dynastic emperors.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔軍士陣歿父母妻子不能自存者，官為存養。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict ordered that where soldiers killed in battle left parents, wives, and children unable to support themselves, officials were to maintain them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, an edict ordered officials to support the parents, wives, and children of soldiers killed in battle who could not support themselves.

sentences.zh: 百姓避兵離散或客死，遺老幼，並資遣還。

translations.literal: Common people who had fled warfare or died away from home, leaving old and young behind, were all given funds and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Common people displaced by war or who died away from home, leaving old and young behind, were given funds and sent home.

sentences.zh: 遠宦卒官，妻子不能歸者，有司給舟車資送。

translations.literal: Where officials died in distant posts and their wives and children could not return, officials were to provide boats, carts, and travel funds to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: Where officials died in distant posts and their families could not return, local officials were to provide transport and funds to send them home.

sentences.zh: 庚申，振河間、廣平、順德、真定饑，蠲租稅。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, famine in Hejian, Guangping, Shunde, and Zhending was relieved and rent and tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, famine relief was granted in Hejian, Guangping, Shunde, and Zhending and rent and tax remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，遣崇禮侯買的裏八剌歸，遺元嗣君書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dingchou, Marquis of Chongli Maidiliba’er was sent home and a letter was left for the Yuan successor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, Marquis of Chongli Maidiliba’er was sent home with a letter to the Yuan successor.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬戌，納哈出犯遼陽，千戶吳壽擊走之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day renxu, Naghachu invaded Liaoyang; Millenary Commander Wu Shou drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on renxu, Naghachu invaded Liaoyang; Millenary Commander Wu Shou drove him off.

sentences.zh: 辛未，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, there was a ceremony at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, sacrifice was performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，召鄧愈、湯和還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuxu, Deng Yu and Tang He were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Deng Yu and Tang He were recalled.

sentences.zh: 是年，阿難功德國、暹羅、琉球、三佛齊、烏斯藏、撒裏、畏兀兒入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, the state of Ananda merit, Siam, Ryukyu, Srivijaya, U-Tsang, Sali, and Uighur presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the state of Ananda merit, Siam, Ryukyu, Srivijaya, U-Tsang, Sali, and the Uighurs sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛未，增祀雞籠山功臣廟一百八人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, the first month, on the day xinwei, one hundred eight more men were added to sacrifice at the meritorious officials’ temple on Jilong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, spring, the first month, on xinwei, one hundred eight more men were added to the meritorious officials’ temple on Jilong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命有司察窮民無告者，給屋舍衣食。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, officials were ordered to investigate poor people with no one to appeal to and give them housing, clothing, and food.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, officials were ordered to find destitute people with no one to help them and provide housing, clothing, and food.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鄧愈、湯和等十三人屯戍北平、陝西、河南。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Deng Yu, Tang He, and twelve others garrisoned Beiping, Shaanxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Deng Yu, Tang He, and twelve others garrisoned Beiping, Shaanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔天下立社學。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict ordered community schools established throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict ordered community schools established throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決開封，發民夫塞之。

translations.literal: In this month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng; corvée laborers were mobilized to block it.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng and corvée laborers were mobilized to repair the breach.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，宥雜犯死罪以下及官犯私罪者，謫鳳陽輸作屯種贖罪。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiawu, pardon was granted below death for miscellaneous crimes and for officials guilty of private offenses; they were banished to Fengyang to perform labor and garrison farming to redeem guilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu, those guilty of miscellaneous crimes short of death and officials guilty of private offenses were pardoned and sent to Fengyang for labor and garrison farming to redeem their guilt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 召徐達、李文忠、馮勝還，傅友德等留鎮北平。

translations.literal: Xu Da, Li Wenzhong, and Feng Sheng were recalled; Fu Youde and others remained to garrison Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da, Li Wenzhong, and Feng Sheng were recalled; Fu Youde and others remained to garrison Beiping.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，立鈔法。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinyou, paper currency regulations were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, the paper currency system was established.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷寶源局鑄錢。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, coin casting at the Baoyuan Bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, coin casting at the Baoyuan Bureau was abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，幸中都。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day xinmao, the emperor visited the central capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinmao, the emperor went to the central capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至自中都。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, he returned from the central capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, he returned from the central capital.

sentences.zh: 免彰德、大名、臨洮、平涼、河州被災田租。

translations.literal: Land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken areas in Zhangde, Daming, Lintao, Pingliang, and Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax was remitted for disaster areas in Zhangde, Daming, Lintao, Pingliang, and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 罷營中都。

translations.literal: Construction of the central capital was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Construction of the central capital was halted.

sentences.zh: 致仕誠意怕劉基卒。

translations.literal: Retired Earl of Chengyi Liu Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Earl of Chengyi Liu Ji died.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，永嘉候硃亮祖偕傅友德鎮北平。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jisi, Marquis of Yongjia Zhu Liangzu together with Fu Youde garrisoned Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, Marquis of Yongjia Zhu Liangzu and Fu Youde garrisoned Beiping.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，指揮同知胡汝平貴州蠻。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, Command Vice Commissioner Hu Ru pacified the barbarians of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, Command Vice Commissioner Hu Ru pacified the peoples of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day jiwei, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day jiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，改作太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the Grand Temple was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Grand Temple was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，召傅友德、硃亮祖還，李文忠、顧時鎮山西、北平。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Fu Youde and Zhu Liangzu were recalled; Li Wenzhong and Gu Shi garrisoned Shanxi and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Fu Youde and Zhu Liangzu were recalled; Li Wenzhong and Gu Shi garrisoned Shanxi and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔百官奔父母喪不俟報。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, an edict ordered that officials rushing home for parents’ funerals need not await approval.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, an edict allowed officials to leave at once for parents’ funerals without awaiting approval.

sentences.zh: 京師地震。

translations.literal: The capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免應天、太平、甯國鎮江及蘄、黃諸府被災田租。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken areas in Yingtian, Taiping, Ningguo, Zhenjiang, and the prefectures of Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, land tax was remitted for disaster areas in Yingtian, Taiping, Ningguo, Zhenjiang, and the Qi and Huang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，元擴廓帖木兒卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiyou, the Yuan Köke Temür died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the Yuan general Köke Temür died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，詔舉富民素行端潔達時務者。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dinghai, an edict sought wealthy commoners of upright conduct who understood current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai, an edict sought wealthy commoners of upright conduct who understood current affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命皇太子諸王講武中都。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the crown prince and princes were ordered to drill troops at the central capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the crown prince and princes were ordered to drill troops at the central capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dingchou, there was a ceremony at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingchou, sacrifice was performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuzi, the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣使振蘇州、湖州、嘉興、松江、常州、太平、甯國、杭州水災。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, envoys were dispatched to relieve flood disaster in Suzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taiping, Ningguo, and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, envoys were sent to relieve flooding in Suzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taiping, Ningguo, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，納哈出犯遼東，指揮馬雲、葉旺大敗之。

translations.literal: In this month, Naghachu invaded Liaodong; Commanders Ma Yun and Ye Wang inflicted a great defeat on him.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Naghachu invaded Liaodong; Commanders Ma Yun and Ye Wang routed him.

sentences.zh: 是年，撒裏、高麗、占城、暹羅、日本、爪哇、三佛齊入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Sali, Goryeo, Champa, Siam, Japan, Java, and Srivijaya presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Sali, Goryeo, Champa, Siam, Japan, Java, and Srivijaya sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，中山侯湯和，潁川侯傅友德，都督僉事藍玉、王弼，中書右丞丁玉，備邊延安。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, the first month, Marquis of Zhongshan Tang He, Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde, Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi, and Right Assistant Grand Councilor Ding Yu guarded the border at Yan’an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, spring, the first month, Marquis of Zhongshan Tang He, Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde, Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi, and Right Assistant Grand Councilor Ding Yu guarded the border at Yan’an.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，詔曰：「比年西征燉煌，北伐沙漠，軍需甲仗，皆資山、陝，又以秦、晉二府宮殿之役，重困吾民。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jimao, an edict said: “In recent years the western campaign to Dunhuang and the northern campaign into the desert have drawn military supplies and armor chiefly from Shanxi and Shaanxi; moreover the palace works of the Qin and Jin princely establishments have heavily burdened our people.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, an edict said: “Recent western campaigns to Dunhuang and northern campaigns into the desert have drawn military supplies chiefly from Shanxi and Shaanxi, and palace construction for the Qin and Jin princely establishments has heavily burdened the people.

sentences.zh: 平定以來，閭閻未息。

translations.literal: Since pacification, the lanes and wards have not yet rested.
translations.idiomatic: Since pacification, ordinary households have not yet recovered.

sentences.zh: 國都始建，土木屢興。

translations.literal: The national capital has only just been built and construction has repeatedly been undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: The national capital has only just been built and construction projects have repeatedly been launched.

sentences.zh: 畿輔既極煩勞，外郡疲於轉運。

translations.literal: The capital region has been taxed to the utmost; outer commanderies are exhausted by transport.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region has been worked to exhaustion and outer commanderies are worn out by transport.

sentences.zh: 今蓄儲有餘，其淮、揚、安、徽、池五府及山西、陝西、河南、福建、江西、浙江、北平、湖廣今年租賦，悉免之。」

translations.literal: Now stores are ample; rent and tax for this year in the five prefectures of Huai, Yang, An, Hui, and Chi and in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Fujian, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Beiping, and Huguang are all remitted.”
translations.idiomatic: Now stores are ample; this year’s rent and tax in Huai, Yang, An, Hui, and Chi prefectures and in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Fujian, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Beiping, and Huguang are all remitted.”

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，京師自去年八月不雨，是日始雨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengxu, the capital had had no rain since the eighth month of last year; on this day rain finally began.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu, the capital had had no rain since the eighth month of the previous year; rain finally began that day.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，自庚戌雨，至是日始霽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guiyou, from gengxu it had rained until this day it finally cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, rain that had begun on gengxu finally cleared.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，改行中書省為承宣佈政使司。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiawu, Branch Secretariats were changed to Provincial Administration Commissions.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, Branch Secretariats were redesignated Provincial Administration Commissions.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李文忠還。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Li Wenzhong returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Li Wenzhong returned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day guichou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day guichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲蘇、松、嘉、湖水災田租，振永平旱災。

translations.literal: In this month, land tax was remitted for flood disaster in Su, Song, Jia, and Hu; drought in Yongping was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood land tax was remitted in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou and drought relief granted in Yongping.

sentences.zh: 元將伯顏帖木兒犯延安，傅友德敗降之。

translations.literal: The Yuan general Bayan Temür invaded Yan’an; Fu Youde defeated and accepted his surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan general Bayan Temür invaded Yan’an; Fu Youde defeated him and accepted his surrender.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，遣官省歷代帝王陵寢，禁芻牧，置守陵戶。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiyou, officials were dispatched to inspect the mausoleums of emperors of successive dynasties, forbid grazing, and establish tomb-guard households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, officials were sent to inspect tombs of successive dynastic emperors, forbid grazing, and establish tomb-guard households.

sentences.zh: 忠臣烈士祠，有司以時葺治。

translations.literal: Shrines to loyal ministers and martyrs were to be repaired by officials at the proper seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines to loyal ministers and martyrs were to be repaired by officials at the proper seasons.

sentences.zh: 分遣國子生修嶽鎮海瀆祠。

translations.literal: Imperial University students were separately dispatched to repair shrines of peaks, mountains, and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial University students were sent out separately to repair shrines of peaks, mountains, and rivers.

sentences.zh: 西番朵兒只巴寇罕東，河州指揮甯正擊走之。

translations.literal: The Tibetan Dorje Zhaba raided Han East; Hezhou Commander Ning Zheng drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan Dorje Zhaba raided Han East; Hezhou Commander Ning Zheng drove him off.

sentences.zh: 閏九月庚寅，以災異詔求直言。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, on the day gengyin, because of calamities and anomalies an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on gengyin, an edict sought blunt counsel because of calamities and anomalies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，太廟成，自是行合享禮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiwei, the Grand Temple was completed; from this the collective spirit-sharing rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, the Grand Temple was completed and the collective spirit-sharing rite was thereafter performed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命秦、晉、燕、吳、楚、齊諸王治兵鳳陽。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Wu, Chu, and Qi were ordered to drill troops at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Wu, Chu, and Qi were ordered to drill troops at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renwu, there was a ceremony at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, sacrifice was performed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 戊子，徙山西及真定民無產者田鳳陽。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, propertyless people from Shanxi and Zhending were relocated to farm at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, propertyless people from Shanxi and Zhending were resettled to farm at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，振畿內、浙江、湖北水災。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiayin, flood disaster in the capital region, Zhejiang, and Hubei was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiayin, flood relief was granted in the capital region, Zhejiang, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣都督同知沐英乘傳詣陝西問民疾苦。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Regional Commander Tongzhi Mu Ying was sent by rapid relay to Shaanxi to inquire into the people’s hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Regional Commander Tongzhi Mu Ying was sent by rapid relay to Shaanxi to inquire into the people’s hardships.

sentences.zh: 是年，覽邦、琉球、安南、日本、烏斯藏、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Lanbang, Ryukyu, Annan, Japan, U-Tsang, and Goryeo presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Lanbang, Ryukyu, Annan, Japan, U-Tsang, and Goryeo sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛卯，以羽林等衛軍益秦、晉、燕三府護衛。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, the first month, on the day xinmao, guards of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princely establishments were augmented with troops from the Feathered Forest and other guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, spring, the first month, on xinmao, the guards of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princely establishments were augmented with troops from the Feathered Forest and other guards.

sentences.zh: 是春，振蘇、松、嘉、湖水災。

translations.literal: In this spring, flood disaster in Su, Song, Jia, and Hu was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, flood relief was granted in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，鄧愈為征西將軍，沐英為副將軍，率師討吐番，大破之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiyou, Deng Yu was made western campaigning general and Mu Ying deputy general; they led an army to attack the Tibetans and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, Deng Yu was appointed western campaigning general and Mu Ying deputy general; they led an army against the Tibetans and routed them.

sentences.zh: 是月，振太平、甯國及宜興、錢塘諸縣水災。

translations.literal: In this month, flood disaster in Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood relief was granted in Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，韓國公李善長、曹國公李文忠總中書省、大都督府、御史台，議軍國重事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengzi, Duke of Han Li Shanchang and Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong jointly directed the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate on weighty military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi, Duke of Han Li Shanchang and Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong jointly directed the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate on major military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，振湖廣水災。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, flood disaster in Huguang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, flood relief was granted in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，戶部主事趙乾振荊、蘄遲緩，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Ministry of Revenue Section Chief Zhao Qian was slow in relieving Jing and Qi; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Ministry of Revenue Section Chief Zhao Qian was executed for delaying relief in Jing and Qi.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，詔臣民言事者，實封達御前。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingsi, an edict ordered that commoners and officials presenting matters use sealed memorials delivered before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi, an edict ordered that petitions from officials and commoners be submitted in sealed form directly to the throne.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命政事啟皇太子裁決奏聞。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, government affairs were ordered to be reported to the crown prince for decision and then memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, government affairs were ordered reported to the crown prince for decision before memorializing the throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，置通政司。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiashen, the Office of Transmission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiashen, the Office of Transmission was established.

sentences.zh: 是月，始遣御史巡按州縣。

translations.literal: In this month, censors were first dispatched to tour and inspect prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month, censors were first dispatched to tour and inspect prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，改建大祀殿於南郊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengxu, the great sacrifice hall at the southern suburbs was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, the great sacrifice hall at the southern suburbs was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，選武臣子弟讀書國子監。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, sons of military officials were selected to study at the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, sons of military officials were selected to study at the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，振紹興、金華、衢州水災。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingshen, flood disaster in Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, flood relief was granted in Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，胡惟庸為左丞相，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Hu Weiyong was made left chancellor and Wang Guangyang right chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Hu Weiyong was appointed left chancellor and Wang Guangyang right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，封沐英四平侯。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuwu, Mu Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, Mu Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜百官公田。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, public fields were granted to the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, public fields were granted to officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，衛國公鄧愈卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guiwei, Duke of Wei Deng Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Duke of Wei Deng Yu died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，合祀天地於奉天殿。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Hall of Complying with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Hall of Complying with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是月，免河南、陝西、廣東、湖廣田租。

translations.literal: In this month, land tax was remitted in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 威茂蠻叛，御史大夫丁玉為平羌將軍，討平之。

translations.literal: The Weimao barbarians rebelled; Censor-in-chief Ding Yu was made pacifying Qiang general and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Weimao peoples rebelled; Censor-in-chief Ding Yu was appointed pacifying Qiang general and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day yisi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the first day yisi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，錄故功臣子孫百百餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, more than one hundred descendants of former meritorious officials were recorded and given offices of differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, more than one hundred descendants of meritorious officials were registered and appointed to offices of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、三佛齊、暹羅、爪哇、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Champa, Srivijaya, Siam, Java, and Zhenla presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Srivijaya, Siam, Java, and Zhenla sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 高麗使五至，以嗣王未立，卻之。

translations.literal: Goryeo envoys came five times; because the successor king had not been installed, they were declined.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo envoys came five times, but because no successor king had been installed, they were turned away.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月甲戌，封皇子椿為蜀王，柏湘王，桂豫王，模漢王，植衛王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, the first month, on the day jiaxu, the princes were enfeoffed: Chun as Prince of Shu, Bai as Prince of Xiang, Gui as Prince of Yu, Mo as Prince of Han, and Zhi as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, spring, the first month, on jiaxu, the princes were enfeoffed: Chun as Prince of Shu, Bai as Prince of Xiang, Gui as Prince of Yu, Mo as Prince of Han, and Zhi as Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 改封吳王橚為周王。

translations.literal: Prince of Wu Su was changed to Prince of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wu Zhu Su was redesignated Prince of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，進封湯和信國公。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Tang He was advanced to Duke of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Tang He was promoted to Duke of Xin.

sentences.zh: 是月，徵天下布政使及知府來朝。

translations.literal: In this month, provincial administration commissioners and prefectural magistrates throughout the realm were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month, provincial administration commissioners and prefectural magistrates from across the empire were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 二月，指揮胡淵平茂州蠻。

translations.literal: In the second month, Commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou peoples.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，命奏事毋關白中書省。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renwu, memorials were ordered not to be routed through the Secretariat for approval.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, memorials were ordered not to require prior Secretariat approval.

sentences.zh: 是月，第來朝官為三等。

translations.literal: In this month, officials coming to court were ranked in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: That month, officials presenting themselves at court were ranked in three grades.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，元嗣君愛猷識理達臘殂，子脫古思帖木兒嗣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the Yuan successor Ayushiridara died; his son Toghus Temür succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, the Yuan successor Ayushiridara died; his son Toghus Temür succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，存問蘇、松、嘉、湖被水災民，戶賜米一石，蠲逋賦六十五萬有奇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingyou, the people of Su, Song, Jia, and Hu who had suffered flood disaster were inquired after; each household was given one picul of grain and more than six hundred fifty thousand in overdue levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingyou, flood victims in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou were visited; each household received one picul of grain and more than six hundred fifty thousand in overdue levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，遣使祭故元嗣君。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renzi, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the former Yuan successor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, envoys were sent to sacrifice to the former Yuan successor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，五開蠻叛，殺靖州指揮過興，以辰州指揮楊仲名為總兵官，討之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Wukai barbarians rebelled and killed Jingzhou Commander Guo Xing; Chenzhou Commander Yang Zhongming was made commander-in-chief to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Wukai peoples rebelled and killed Jingzhou Commander Guo Xing; Chenzhou Commander Yang Zhongming was appointed commander-in-chief to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，振平陽饑。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingchou, famine in Pingyang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingchou, famine relief was granted in Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，蘇、松、揚、臺海溢，遣官存恤。

translations.literal: In this month, Su, Song, Yang, and coastal Taizhou overflowed; officials were dispatched to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Suzhou, Songjiang, Yangzhou, and coastal Taizhou flooded; officials were sent to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德諸府州秋糧。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, autumn grain tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, Guangde, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, autumn grain tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, Guangde, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，追封劉繼祖為義惠侯。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingshen, Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yihui.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yihui.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，大祀殿成。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiazi, the great sacrifice hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi, the great sacrifice hall was completed.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，征西將軍西平侯沐英率都督藍玉、玉弼討西番。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengwu, western campaigning general Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying led Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi to attack the western barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengwu, western campaigning general Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying led Regional Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi against the western peoples.

sentences.zh: 是月，五開蠻平。

translations.literal: In this month, the Wukai barbarians were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Wukai peoples were pacified.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、闍婆、高麗、琉球、占城、三佛齊、朵甘、烏斯藏、彭亨、百花入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Siam, Java, Goryeo, Ryukyu, Champa, Srivijaya, Mdo-khams, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Siam, Java, Goryeo, Ryukyu, Champa, Srivijaya, Mdo-khams, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月己卯，始合禮天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, the first month, on the day jimao, Heaven and Earth were first jointly sacrificed to at the southern suburbs according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, spring, the first month, on jimao, Heaven and Earth were first jointly sacrificed to at the southern suburbs in the new rite.

sentences.zh: 甲申，洮州十八族番叛，命沐英移兵討之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the eighteen Tibetan clans of Taozhou rebelled; Mu Ying was ordered to shift troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the eighteen Tibetan clans of Taozhou rebelled; Mu Ying was ordered to shift troops against them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，丁玉平松州蠻。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou peoples.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，李文忠督理河、岷、臨、鞏軍事。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuxu, Li Wenzhong supervised military affairs along the He, Min, Lin, and Gong rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, Li Wenzhong supervised military affairs along the He, Min, Lin, and Gong rivers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「今春雨雪經旬。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict said: “Now spring rain and snow have lasted more than ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict said: “Spring rain and snow have now lasted more than ten days.

sentences.zh: 天下貧民困於饑寒者多有，其令有司給以鈔。

translations.literal: Many poor people throughout the realm are distressed by hunger and cold; let officials give them paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Many poor people across the empire suffer hunger and cold; let officials give them paper money.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，信國公湯和率列候練兵臨清。

translations.literal: ” On the day bingyin, Duke of Xin Tang He led the ranked marquises to drill troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingyin, Duke of Xin Tang He led the ranked marquises to drill troops at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，蠲北平田租。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day guiwei, land tax in Beiping was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guiwei, land tax in Beiping was remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，都督馬雲征大寧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, Regional Commander Ma Yun campaigned against Daning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao, Regional Commander Ma Yun campaigned against Daning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，丁玉回師討眉縣賊，平之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingchen, Ding Yu returned his army to attack the bandits of Meixian and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, Ding Yu returned his army to attack bandits in Meixian and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 己未，李文忠還掌大都督府事。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Li Wenzhong returned to direct affairs of the Chief Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Li Wenzhong resumed direction of the Chief Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，詔凡致仕官復其家，終身無所與。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinsi, an edict ordered that retired officials’ households be restored and that for life they owe nothing to the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, an edict restored retired officials’ households and exempted them for life from state obligations.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，沐英大破西番，擒其部長三副使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jihai, Mu Ying inflicted a great defeat on the western barbarians and captured three vice ministers of their tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jihai, Mu Ying routed the western peoples and captured three tribal vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，沐英班師，封仇成、藍玉等十二人為侯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day jiawu, Mu Ying returned his army; Qiu Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiawu, Mu Ying returned; Qiu Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were enfeoffed as marquises.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大寧平。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Daning was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Daning was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月，汪廣洋貶廣南，賜死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Guangnan and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wang Guangyang was demoted to Guangnan and ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 徵天下博學老成之士至京師。

translations.literal: Learned and mature scholars throughout the realm were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Learned and mature scholars from across the empire were summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、暹羅、日本、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annan, and Goryeo presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annan, and Goryeo sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢黃金百斤、白金萬兩，以不如約，卻之。

translations.literal: Goryeo presented one hundred catties of gold and ten thousand taels of silver; because this did not accord with regulations, it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo presented one hundred catties of gold and ten thousand taels of silver; because this exceeded regulations, it was refused.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月戊戌，左丞相胡惟庸謀反，及其黨御史大夫陳甯、中丞塗節等伏誅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, the first month, on the day wuxu, Left Chancellor Hu Weiyong plotted rebellion; he and his partisans Censor-in-chief Chen Ning, Vice Censor-in-chief Tu Jie, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, spring, the first month, on wuxu, Left Chancellor Hu Weiyong plotted rebellion; he and his associates Censor-in-chief Chen Ning and Vice Censor-in-chief Tu Jie were executed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 罷中書省，廢丞相等官，更定六部官秩，改大都督府為中、左、右、前、後五軍都督府。

translations.literal: The Secretariat was abolished and the offices of chancellor and the like were discarded; the ranks of the Six Ministries were revised; the Chief Military Commission was changed to five military commissions: central, left, right, front, and rear.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was abolished along with the chancellorship; the Six Ministries were reorganized; and the Chief Military Commission was divided into five military commissions: central, left, right, front, and rear.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，詔舉聰明正直、孝弟力田、賢良方正、文學術數之士。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, renxu, an edict sought men of keen intelligence and upright conduct, filial piety and diligent farming, worthy integrity, literary learning, and occult calculation.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, renxu, an edict sought men of keen intelligence, upright conduct, filial piety, diligent farming, worthy integrity, literary learning, and technical skill.

sentences.zh: 發丹符，驗天下金穀之數。

translations.literal: Red tallies were issued to verify the empire’s gold and grain accounts.
translations.idiomatic: Red tallies were issued to audit the empire’s gold and grain accounts.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，文武官年六十以上者聽致仕，給以誥敕。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, civil and military officials sixty years of age and above were permitted to retire and were given patent letters of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, civil and military officials sixty and older were permitted to retire with patent letters of appointment.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，減蘇、松、嘉、湖重賦十之二。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renchen, the heavy levies of Su, Song, Jia, and Hu were reduced by two tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, the heavy levies of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou were reduced by two tenths.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，燕王隸之國北平。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Prince of Yan took up his fief in Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Prince of Yan went to his fief in Beiping.

sentences.zh: 壬子，沐英襲元將脫火赤於亦集乃，擒之，盡降其眾。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Mu Ying surprised the Yuan general Toqto’a at Ejinay and captured him, completely accepting the surrender of his host.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Mu Ying surprised the Yuan general Toqto’a at Ejinay, captured him, and accepted the surrender of his entire force.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，命群臣各舉所知。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jichou, ministers and officials were each ordered to recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jichou, ministers and officials were each ordered to recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，雷震謹身殿。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiawu, lightning struck the Hall of Cultivating the Body.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, lightning struck the Hall of Cultivating the Body.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, a general amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a general amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，釋在京及臨濠屯田輸作者。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, corvée laborers in the capital and at Linhuo garrison fields were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, corvée laborers in the capital and at Linhuo garrison fields were released.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免天下田租。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, land tax throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, land tax throughout the empire was remitted.

sentences.zh: 吏以過誤罷者還其職。

translations.literal: Officials dismissed for minor faults were restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Officials dismissed for minor faults were restored to office.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，都督濮英進兵赤斤站，獲故元豳王亦憐真及其部曲而還。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Regional Commander Pu Ying advanced to Chijin station, captured the former Yuan Prince of Bin Yilianzhen and his followers, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Regional Commander Pu Ying advanced to Chijin station, captured the former Yuan Prince of Bin Yilianzhen and his followers, and returned.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷御史台。

translations.literal: In this month, the Censorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Censorate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 命從征士卒老疾者許以子代，老而無子及寡婦，有司資遣還。

translations.literal: Campaigning soldiers who were old or ill were permitted to have sons take their place; the old without sons and widows were to be given funds by officials and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign soldiers who were old or ill could have sons take their place; the old without sons and widows were to be given funds and sent home.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，雷震奉天門，避正殿省愆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingyin, lightning struck the Gate of Complying with Heaven; the emperor left the main hall to repent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin, lightning struck the Gate of Complying with Heaven; the emperor left the main hall to repent.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷王府工役。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, labor service for princely establishments was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, labor service for princely establishments was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，置諫院官。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, remonstrance bureau offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, remonstrance bureau offices were established.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，命天下學校師生，日給廩膳。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, teachers and students in schools throughout the realm were given daily grain rations from the state granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, teachers and students in schools across the empire were given daily grain rations from state granaries.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，景川侯曹震、營陽侯楊璟、永城侯恭顯屯田北平。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinmao, Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, Marquis of Yingyang Yang Jing, and Marquis of Yongcheng Gong Xian garrisoned fields in Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao, Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, Marquis of Yingyang Yang Jing, and Marquis of Yongcheng Gong Xian organized garrison farming in Beiping.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天壽節，始受群臣朝賀，賜宴於謹身殿，後以為常。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, at the Heaven’s Longevity festival the emperor first received court congratulations from ministers and granted a banquet in the Hall of Cultivating the Body; this thereafter became the rule.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, at the Heaven’s Longevity festival the emperor first received court congratulations and granted a banquet in the Hall of Cultivating the Body; this became the regular practice.

sentences.zh: 丙午，置四輔官，告於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, four assistant offices were established and reported at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, four assistant offices were established and announced at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 以儒士王本、估佑、襲斅、杜斅、趙民望、吳源為春、夏官。

translations.literal: The Confucian scholars Wang Ben, Gu You, Gong Zhuo, Du Zhuo, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were made spring and summer officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Confucian scholars Wang Ben, Gu You, Gong Zhuo, Du Zhuo, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were appointed spring and summer officials.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔陝西衛軍以三分之二屯田。

translations.literal: In this month, an edict ordered that two thirds of Shaanxi guard troops garrison fields.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict ordered two thirds of Shaanxi guard troops to garrison farm.

sentences.zh: 安置翰林學士承旨宋濂於茂州，道卒。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Chancellor Song Lian was settled at Maozhou and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Chancellor Song Lian was resettled at Maozhou and died on the journey.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未，徐達還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day yiwei, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on yiwei, Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 丙午，元平章完者不花、乃兒不花犯永平，指揮劉廣戰沒，千戶王輅擊敗之，擒完者不花。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the Yuan Vice Ministers Qanbuya Xin and Nirbuqa invaded Yongping; Commander Liu Guang died in battle; Millenary Commander Wang Luo defeated them and captured Qanbuya Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Yuan vice ministers Qanbuya Xin and Nirbuqa invaded Yongping; Commander Liu Guang was killed; Millenary Commander Wang Luo defeated them and captured Qanbuya Xin.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天下府州縣所舉士至者八百六十餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, more than eight hundred sixty scholars recommended by prefectures and counties throughout the realm arrived and were given offices of differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, more than eight hundred sixty scholars recommended by prefectures and counties arrived and were appointed to offices of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 南雄侯趙庸鎮廣東，討陽春蠻。

translations.literal: Marquis of Nanxiong Zhao Yong garrisoned Guangdong and attacked the Yangchun barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Nanxiong Zhao Yong garrisoned Guangdong and attacked the Yangchun peoples.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、日本、安南、占城、真臘、爪哇入貢，日本以無表卻之。

translations.literal: In this year, Ryukyu, Japan, Annan, Champa, Zhenla, and Java presented tribute; Japan was declined because it sent no formal memorial.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Ryukyu, Japan, Annan, Champa, Zhenla, and Java sent tribute; Japan was refused for sending no formal memorial.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月戊子，徐達為征虜大將軍，湯和、傅友德為左、右副將軍，帥師討乃兒不花。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, spring, the first month, on the day wuzi, Xu Da was made great general for the campaign against the barbarians; Tang He and Fu Youde were left and right deputy generals, leading an army to attack Nirbuqa.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, spring, the first month, on wuzi, Xu Da was appointed great general for the northern campaign; Tang He and Fu Youde were left and right deputies leading an army against Nirbuqa.

sentences.zh: 命新授官者各舉所知。

translations.literal: Newly appointed officials were each ordered to recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed officials were each ordered to recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷天下歲造兵器。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the annual manufacture of weapons throughout the realm was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, annual weapons manufacture throughout the empire was halted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命公候子弟入國學。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, sons of dukes and marquises were ordered to enter the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, sons of dukes and marquises were ordered to enter the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔求隱逸。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict sought reclusive scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict sought reclusive scholars.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，核天下官田。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengchen, official fields throughout the realm were audited.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, official fields throughout the empire were audited.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingxu, a general amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, a general amnesty was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，頒《五經》、《四書》於北方學校。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Five Classics and Four Books were distributed to northern schools.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Five Classics and Four Books were distributed to schools in the north.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，徐達率諸將出塞，至北黃河，擊破元兵，獲全寧四部以歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengwu, Xu Da led the generals out beyond the passes, reached the Northern Yellow River, defeated Yuan troops, and returned with the four tribes of Quanning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengwu, Xu Da led the generals beyond the passes to the Northern Yellow River, defeated Yuan troops, and returned with the four tribes of Quanning.

sentences.zh: 五月，五溪蠻叛，江夏侯周德興討平之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Wuxi barbarians rebelled; Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Wuxi peoples rebelled; Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙子，詔求明經老成之士，有司禮送京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day bingzi, an edict sought elderly scholars versed in the classics; officials were to escort them to the capital with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on bingzi, an edict sought elderly scholars versed in the classics; officials were to escort them to the capital with ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，河決原武、祥符、中牟。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Yellow River burst its banks at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Yellow River burst its banks at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徐達還。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Xu Da returned.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔，傅友德為征南將軍，藍玉、沐英為左、右副將軍，帥征支南。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, renwu, Fu Youde was made southern campaigning general; Lan Yu and Mu Ying were left and right deputy generals, leading a campaign against Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, renwu, Fu Youde was appointed southern campaigning general; Lan Yu and Mu Ying were left and right deputies leading a campaign against Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 徐達鎮北平。

translations.literal: Xu Da garrisoned Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da garrisoned Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丙午，周德興移師討施州蠻，平之。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Zhou Dexing shifted his army to attack the Shizhou barbarians and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhou Dexing shifted his army to attack the Shizhou peoples and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day renzi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day renzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命法司錄囚，會翰林院給事中及春坊官會議平允以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the judiciary was ordered to record prisoners; Hanlin Academy supervising secretaries and Eastern Palace officials were to meet and discuss fair judgments before reporting.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the judiciary was ordered to review prisoners; Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials were to meet, discuss fair judgments, and report.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免應天、太平、應德、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, land tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Yingde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, land tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Yingde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，分遣御史錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, censors were separately dispatched to record prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, censors were separately dispatched to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，延安侯唐勝宗帥師討浙東山寇，平之。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Marquis of Yan’an Tang Shengzong led troops to attack mountain bandits in eastern Zhe and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Marquis of Yan’an Tang Shengzong led troops against mountain bandits in eastern Zhejiang and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，吉安侯陸仲亨鎮成都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renwu, Marquis of Ji’an Lu Zhongheng garrisoned Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, Marquis of Ji’an Lu Zhongheng garrisoned Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，趙庸討廣州海寇，大破之。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Zhao Yong attacked sea bandits in Guangzhou and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhao Yong attacked sea bandits in Guangzhou and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，命翰林春坊官考駁諸司章奏。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials were ordered to examine and assess memorials from the various offices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials were ordered to examine memorials from the various offices.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，傅友德大敗元兵於白石江，遂下曲靖。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Fu Youde inflicted a great defeat on Yuan troops at the White Stone River and then took Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Fu Youde routed Yuan troops at the White Stone River and then took Qujing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密走普寧自殺。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Yuan Liang prince Basalawarmi fled to Puning and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Yuan Liang prince Basalawarmi fled to Puning and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、安南、爪哇、朵甘、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: In this year, Siam, Annan, Java, Mdo-khams, and U-Tsang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Siam, Annan, Java, Mdo-khams, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 以安南寇思明，不納。

translations.literal: Because Annan raided Siming, tribute was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Annan had raided Siming, its tribute was not accepted.
